test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:**

P. But the fleet was caught off guard as a sudden, strong storm blew in from the sea.

Q. Confident in their strategy to blockade the enemy port, the admiral gave the order for the ships to proceed.

R. The conflict became a desperate struggle for survival due to the unanticipated weather.

S. Without firing a shot, they were to cut off supplies and compel a surrender.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Q, S, P, R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph starts with sentence **Q**, which sets the context of the admiral giving orders and describing the strategy of blockading the enemy port.
 
• Next is sentence **S**, which elaborates on the details of the strategy (cutting off supplies and forcing a surrender).
 
• Sentence **P** follows, describing the unexpected storm that caught the fleet off guard.
 
• Finally, sentence **R** concludes, emphasizing the desperate struggle for survival caused by the storm.

Correct paragraph: *Confident in their strategy to blockade the enemy port, the admiral gave the order for the ships to proceed. Without firing a shot, they were to cut off supplies and compel a surrender. But the fleet was caught off guard as a sudden, strong storm blew in from the sea. The conflict became a desperate struggle for survival due to the unanticipated weather.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Logical flow:** The sentences are arranged to maintain coherence and to narrate the events chronologically while ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• **Tip:** Look for connecting ideas and cause-effect relationships between sentences when rearranging them.
